title: Claude Code is not logged in for the service user
fix: On the board host, as the user that runs the Paperclip service: run `claude`, then /login. Then re-wake the issue. Each wake fails 3 times (2 retries 30s apart), so one root cause shows as several runs.

title: Claude Code is not logged in for the service user (CLI engine)
fix: Same fix: run `claude` then /login as the service user on the board host, then re-wake.

title: `claude` is not on the service's PATH
fix: Re-run scripts/control-plane/install.sh: it re-pins the launcher PATH to include ~/.local/bin and Homebrew. Or set an absolute adapter command on the agent.

title: An agent CLI (claude/codex/gh) is not on the service's PATH
fix: Re-run scripts/control-plane/install.sh (launcher PATH), then re-wake. Under launchd the PATH is minimal.

title: Codex has no credentials for the service user
fix: On the board host, as the service user: `codex login` (ChatGPT), with no CODEX_HOME override; or bind OPENAI_API_KEY to the agent. Confirm with the codex auth-signal row below, then clear the recovery action and re-wake.

title: Codex ChatGPT login expired or was revoked
fix: `codex login` again as the service user, then re-wake.

title: Agent configuration is incomplete (a required secret or setting is missing)
fix: Read the run error and the issue's recovery action (listed below); bind the missing secret on the agent, then resolve the recovery action and re-wake.

title: The project's repo could not be cloned on the board host
fix: Make `git ls-remote <repoUrl>` succeed as the service user (credentials, CA trust, network); scripts/control-plane/preflight.sh checks every package repo. Then re-wake.

title: Execution workspace could not be prepared
fix: See the run log's 'Failed to prepare' line (shown below when available).

title: Hermes agent points at a plain-HTTP remote URL
fix: Use the https:// Tailscale Serve URL from scripts/node/expose-gateway.sh hermes; never set dangerouslyAllowInsecureRemoteHttp.

title: Hermes gateway unreachable
fix: Start the Hermes API server on that host and re-run expose-gateway.sh (Serve mappings get lost on Tailscale upgrades); then re-invoke.

title: Hermes gateway rejected the stored key
fix: The agent's apiKey no longer matches that host's API_SERVER_KEY: update the agent's key (company secret), then re-invoke.

title: OpenClaw wants a device approval
fix: Approve the pending device in OpenClaw on that host (`openclaw devices approve --latest`). If it repeats every run, the agent has no persisted device key: re-join via the OpenClaw invite flow.

title: OpenClaw gateway unreachable
fix: Start the OpenClaw gateway and check its Tailscale Serve front; then re-invoke.

title: The agent's ACP session failed
fix: Read the error line below; common causes are provider quota or rate limits and an expired login. Re-wake after fixing it.

title: Run process was lost (server restart or crash)
fix: If the server-log section shows EPIPE crashes, that's an upstream bug (launchd restarts the server). Otherwise check `paperclipai service logs`. Re-wake affected issues.

title: Run timed out
fix: Check the run log for where it stalled; raise timeoutSec on the agent only if the work legitimately needs longer.
